fee_notes: Royalty is tiered by service category (not a single flat %): 7% exhaust systems; 5.5% engine/transmission replacement, engine diagnostics, engine seals/mounts/gaskets, transmission mounts, scheduled maintenance; 4% batteries; 3% tires, state inspections, towing, emissions inspections; 5% all other Authorized Products and Services. Annual minimum royalty of $20,800 (weekly minimum $400 = 1/52 of annual). If lower rates are not properly reported via approved computer systems, rate reverts to 7%; unauthorized services at 7%; unreported services at 8%. MAF contribution is 8% of Gross Revenues generally, but only 1.5% on tires, towing, and government-regulated inspections. New centers in first 12 weeks: weekly MAF = greater of 8% of Gross Revenues or $250. Under Advertising Addendum Version 2, MAF may be reduced to 6% (Tier One) or 5.5% (Tier Two) after initial 12-month period. Royalty incentives available for multi-unit developers (Development Incentive Addendum: 1%/1%/3-or-min for 3 years), existing franchisees opening additional units (75% reduction first 6 months), conversion franchisees (50% reduction first 2 years), and VetFran veterans (50% reduction first 6 months). Technology fees capped at $750/month aggregate (Monthly Technology Cap) for ongoing software/tech fees, subject to CPI adjustment starting January 30, 2026 every 5 years. M.Key Software Maintenance Fee: $375/month basic (or $275/month if AutoVitals purchased); optional add-ons up to $200/month Technical Procedures Software, $25/month QuickBooks Integration, $59/month Motovisuals; AutoVitals eInspection $245/month basic + $24/month per additional technician tablet above 3. AutoNet TV: $30–$50/month (not to exceed $100/month). Franchisee Profitability Program Software Fee: $14.95/month (optional). Technology Administrative Fee: $100/month (penalty, payable until corrected if computer system not kept updated).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fees: You are required to pay the greater of an annual minimum royalty in the amount of $20,800 or a calculated royalty based on the following percentages of Gross Revenues on the identified categories of Authorized Products and Services: 7% of exhaust systems; 5.5% replacement of engines or transmissions, engine diagnostics, engine seals, mounts and gaskets, transmission mounts, scheduled maintenance; 4% of batteries; 3% of tires, state inspections, towing services, Emissions Inspections; 5% of all other Authorized Products and Services. On or before the day of each week that we periodically specify (the "Payment Day"), currently, Wednesday, you are required to pay the greater of 1/52 of the annual minimum royalty (which equals $400) or your calculated royalty.

Meineke Advertising Fund (the "MAF") Contributions: 8% of your Gross Revenues; however, your MAF contribution will be 1.5% of your Gross Revenues from the sale of tires, towing services, and government-regulated inspections. Payable on or before the Payment Day, currently, Wednesday. If, however, your Center is a new Meineke Center, during the 12-week period following the opening of your Center, your weekly MAF contribution will be the greater of 8% of your Gross Revenues or $250.

Technology Administrative Fee: $100 per month. As incurred. Payable until corrected if you fail to keep your computer system updated.

Franchisee Profitability Program Software Fees: Currently, $14.95 per month. Monthly.

M.Key Software Maintenance Fee: $375 Basic Software Maintenance Fee (or, if you purchase AutoVitals, $275). Additional options: Up to $200 per month – Technical Procedures Software; $25 per month – Quick Books Integration; $59 per month Motovisuals. AutoVitals (eInspection): $399 one-time setup fee; $245 per month basic package; $24 per month for each additional technician tablet above the 3 tablets provided with the basic package.

AutoNet TV Fee: $30 to $50 per month, subject to periodic adjustment, but will not exceed $100 per month.
